detaileddescription.para: VCI. For the VCI order $ k $, the basis $ \boldsymbol{P}(\boldsymbol{Y}) $ is the complete monomial basis of degree $ \le k $ in $ n_{\text{dim}} $ variables (Math::computeMonomialBasis()), with $ n_C = \binom{k + n_{\text{dim}}}{n_{\text{dim}}} $ entries, evaluated at the particle center. With the particle volume $ V_Y $ in the reference intermediate configuration as the integration weight, the particle contributes \[ \int \partial_i T_A\, P_C \,dV \approx \partial_i T_A\, P_C\, V_Y, \qquad \int T_A\, \partial_i P_C \,dV \approx T_A\, \partial_i P_C\, V_Y, \qquad M_{ACD} \approx \chi_A\, P_C\, P_D\, V_Y, \] where $ \chi_A \in \{0, 1\} $ indicates whether the particle center is in the support of kernel function $ A $. The correction assigned by vci_assignTestFunctionCorrectionTerms() is $ \partial_i T_A \mathrel{+}= \chi_A \sum_C \eta_{AiC} P_C $. The boundary integral depends on the kinematics of the physics and is left to the derived classes.
Derived classes must keep _centerReferenceIntermediate, _volReferenceIntermediate, _P and _P_Gradient up to date in acceptStateAndPosition().
